channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Fuel tanker blast in western Iran kills at least 10
item.description: At least six other people were injured in the tanker blast on Iran's Hamedan-Sanandaj highway, officials say.

item.title: Colombian government reports three killed in rebel attack on military post
item.description: Colombian authorities blame ELN rebel group for attack that reportedly included drones dropping explosives on compound.

item.title: Two pilots killed after Greek fighter jet crashes during an air show
item.description: Greek authorities say that the two pilots onboard an F-4 Phantom fighter jet have been killed after it crashed.

item.title: Russia’s Putin meets US envoys to discuss Trump proposal to end Ukraine war
item.description: Russia and Ukraine pledge not to strike each other's capitals for three days during talks in Moscow and Kyiv.

item.title: Gaza teams recover remains of 55 people nearly 3 years after Israeli strike
item.description: The victims, all from one Palestinian family, had been sheltering at their family home when Israel hit it.

item.title: Israel claims control of Lebanon’s key Ali al-Taher ridge: What that means
item.description: Israeli Defence Ministry asserts operational control over strategic highland; Hezbollah yet to comment.

item.title: US says it hit three Iranian oil tankers after attacks on warships
item.description: US Central Command says its forces struck three Iranian crude oil carriers on Saturday.

item.title: US and Iran trade retaliatory attacks on ships as conflict flares
item.description: The US says it hit three Iranian oil tankers, while Iran says it targeted three US-linked ships.

item.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
item.description: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.

item.title: How could US-Iran conflict end? Three experts give their views
item.description: After renewed strikes this week, does either side have an exit strategy?
